Use the scoped form instead: `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- <cmd>`, which is verified to work. Direct binaries also exist under ~/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24.20.0/bin/.

Your tasks, in order:

1. Install dependencies: run `cd /home/ubuntu/hevy-mcp-effect-deepening && mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- pnpm install` (use a long timeout, e.g. 600s). Report success/failure and any install warnings. Do NOT modify mise.toml or any repo config to work around kiota — the scoped exec form is the approved workaround.

2. Verify the Effect guidance file now exists: read /home/ubuntu/hevy-mcp-effect-deepening/node_modules/effect/AGENTS.md and confirm its presence plus the effect version installed (check node_modules/effect/package.json version, and what packages/core/package.json requests).

3. Verify the toolchain end-to-end with fast checks only (do NOT run the full test suite):
   - `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- pnpm run check:types` (report pass/fail; this may take a few minutes — allow 600s)
   - A smoke unit test on ONE small package, e.g. `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- pnpm run test:unit -- packages/operations/src/user.test.ts` (report pass/fail and duration)
   - `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- pnpm run check` (oxlint + oxfmt check; report pass/fail). Note: check includes check:openapi and check:generated — if check:openapi needs network to api.hevyapp.com and fails with ENOTFOUND, report that separately as an expected sandbox limitation, and try `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- npx oxlint . --type-aware --type-check` plus `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- npx oxfmt . --check` individually to isolate lint/format status.

4. Inventory verification: confirm these are usable in the environment:
   - node 24 (mise exec node@24 -- node --version)
   - pnpm 12
   - vitest (via the smoke test above)
   - oxlint/oxfmt (via step 3)
   - changesets CLI: `mise exec node@24 pnpm@12 -- pnpm run check:changeset` — report whether it passes on this branch (it compares --since origin/main; if it fails because the base branch differs, capture the exact error)
   - hk hooks: check whether git hooks are installed for the worktree (git config core.hooksPath, and ls of the worktree gitdir hooks at /home/ubuntu/hevy-mcp/.git/worktrees/hevy-mcp-effect-deepening/hooks). Do NOT install hooks; just report status.

5. Network probes (read-only, quick):
   - Can we reach registry.npmjs.org? (the pnpm install result answers this)
   - Can we reach api.hevyapp.com? Try `mise exec node@24 -- node -e "fetch('https://api.hevyapp.com/v1/user', {signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000)}).then(r=>console.log('status',r.status)).catch(e=>console.log('ERR',e.message))"` — report reachable/unreachable. This determines whether credential-gated live lanes can run at all in this sandbox.

Return an inline structured report (do not write files): dependency inventory with verification status for each item, exact commands that passed/failed, the effect version, hooks status, network reachability results, and any blockers with concrete options.
